Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000998": On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
- memory_id "1000994": On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000983": On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Ember team, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000962": On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, billing service)
- memory_id "1000954": As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000950": As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000854": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000782" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000625" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000615": INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017, expired intermediate certificate)
- memory_id "1000611": INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000589": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000543": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000540": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas observed that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the notifier is not Team Atlas's service.  (about: Team Atlas, notifier)
- memory_id "1000372": On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000368": On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000236": The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000178": Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
